page_title: BOU 1-2 BRE | Bournemouth v Brentford 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+13' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
90+8' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Matthew Donohue ignores the protests.

90+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo displays great vision and sends a pass to Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 1:2.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
89' 1 - 1 Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the left post.
86' 0 - 1 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
85' A yellow card for a tackle by Mathias Jensen (Brentford). Matthew Donohue doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
83' Substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) replaces Vitaly Janelt.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Smith trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth).
80' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Ryan Christie is replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
75' The Brentford players can’t believe it after referee Matthew Donohue signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
74' Substitution. Kevin Schade (Brentford) has come on for Mikkel Damsgaard.
73' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Brentford, he's going to review using VAR.

73' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matthew Donohue no option but to blow his whistle. Brentford are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
67' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) replacing Dango Ouattara.
67' Justin Kluivert will be replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
67' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.

65' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
65' The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.
63' Here is a change. Keane Lewis-Potter is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Yoane Wissa (Brentford).
63' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Christian Norgaard will be replaced by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) will replace Kristoffer Ajer.
58' The game is interrupted. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
56' Matthew Donohue shows a yellow card to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) for a tough tackle.
55' The ball is cleared after Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and Matthew Donohue blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Matthew Donohue shows a yellow card to Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Matthew Donohue blows for a foul after Adam Smith (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
43' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
37' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Matthew Donohue blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' Referee Matthew Donohue halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Andoni Iraola, then shows him a yellow.
34' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

34' Ivan Toney (Brentford) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Brentford can continue in their attacking effort.
34' Wow, what an escape. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Celebrations are cut short for Bournemouth as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
29' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Matthew Donohue makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
27' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) scores a goal! He latches onto a lovely pass that puts him one-on-one with the keeper before producing a fine strike that goes into the left side of the net!
23' Chance! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

21' A sweet pass finds Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Mark Flekken is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
20' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Now Brentford have a corner.

18' Ivan Toney (Brentford) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. Brentford force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
17' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
14' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
11' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
8' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

8' He should have scored! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Mark Travers makes an easy save. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
5' A quickly taken corner by Brentford.
4' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
2' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
1' The match has just started.
Brentford will kick-off.
Matthew Donohue is introduced as the referee for today's match.
